jobs.description: Rebuild this exact Chinese high-school student, wooden school desk and chair as a coherent NORTH-EAST facing THREE-QUARTER REAR VIEW station, viewed from a slightly elevated camera behind the student's left shoulder. This is a new camera angle for the whole desk, chair and student together, not a flat rotation of pixels. The desk's top and right side are diagonal in the image; the student sits at its near lower-left edge facing toward the upper-right. Retain the student's short dark navy hair, white tracksuit shirt with royal-blue collar/side panels and sleeves, blue trousers, dark shoes; same compact chibi proportions and native pixel density as the reference. Clearly SITTING: pelvis rests on the wooden chair seat, thighs point toward the desk under the desktop, knees bent, lower legs descend to the floor, two shoes close and naturally apart rather than a wide standing stance. Show back of head and only a narrow side of cheek. Chair has a low wooden backrest in the foreground occluding ONLY lower back/hips, a visible seat edge, and straight legs aligned on the ground; not a huge slab covering shoulders. Upper body leans slightly forward; both elbows low, left hand holds a cream notebook flat on the desktop and right hand holds a pencil with its tip touching the page. Correct contact and occlusion everywhere, desk/chair/student at same perspective and scale, no intersecting furniture, no floating hips or feet. Keep full station centered inside a 64x64 transparent canvas with 3 pixels padding, character roughly 30-34 pixels tall in seated pose, hard pixel edges, compact dark outlines, muted tan wood and existing blue-white palette. Single complete station, no room, no floor tile, no text, no labels, no extra people, no duplicate hands, no full side view, no pure back view.
